brief:
A documentary following journalists from the Agence France-Presse news agency after the October 7, 2023 attack has won the Best Documentary Film award at Montreal's Cinemania Film Festival, Al-Monitor reported. The film, titled "Inside Gaza," traces the work of AFP correspondents covering the conflict in the aftermath of the assault.

The award was presented Saturday at the festival, which showcases cinema from around the world.
dek: "Inside Gaza," a documentary that follows journalists from global news agency AFP after the October 7, 2023 attack, received the Best Documentary Film award at Montreal's Cinemania Film Festival.
title: Inside Gaza" wins best documentary at Montreal festival
